scope: G4c round 4: out-of-sample tests of the DERIVED formulas. Rounds 1-3 measured a law; the proof program (t1_g4c_proof.md) now derives it, and a derivation that only reproduces what was already measured has not yet been tested. These cells have never been run at any point.

what_changed_since_round_3.the_reduction: D(j,k)^2 * R = ||w_j - w_k||^2 with w_j = M Phi(x_j) and M = I - (1/R) 1 1^T, so the flex condition is EXACTLY that the profile cloud {w_j} moves as an infinitesimal isometry of V = ker(1^T) ~ R^(R-1). Every regime then follows from linear algebra rather than from inspection.
what_changed_since_round_3.the_decomposition: nullity = dim ker L + dim(Im L cap Flex), where L is the derivative of the scene -> profile-cloud map. Verified exactly on 15 previously-measured cells.

closed_forms_now_derived.R <= d+1: L is surjective, so nullity = dR + n(d - R + 1) + R(R-1)/2
closed_forms_now_derived.R >= d+2: threshold n >= [dR + m(m+1)/2 - d(d+1)/2] / (m - d) with m = R-1
closed_forms_now_derived.at R = d+2: m - d = 1, and the count collapses to n = d^2 + 3d + 1

what_changed_since_round_3.honest_status_of_that_agreement: The closed forms reproduce all 8 previously-measured nullity cells and all 10 previously-measured thresholds exactly. That is post-hoc agreement, NOT preregistration -- but the formulas carry zero free parameters, which is what distinguishes a derivation reproducing data from a fit absorbing it. Round 4 is the part that is preregistered.
what_changed_since_round_3.the_p11_correction: Round 3 labelled n = d^2 + 3d + 1 speculative, a three-point quadratic with no derivation behind it. It has one: it is the R = d + 2 case of the dimension count, where m - d = 1 makes the division trivial. The tag was right at the time and is now superseded.

predictions.falsified_if: the slope is not 3, or the intercept is not 30
predictions.basis: the first slope-3 cell ever run. Round 2 separated slope 1 from slope d - R + 1 by exhibiting a 2; this separates a hypothetical 'slope is 1 or 2' from the formula. It also tests the INTERCEPT, which rounds 1-3 never did in an under-observed cell.

predictions.falsified_if: nullity is not 63, or varies with n

the R = d + 2 closed form at a dimension beyond every measurement so far, where it reads 36 + 18 + 1 = 55. The largest scene in the series.

what_a_miss_would_mean.P14_or_P15: the closed form for R <= d+1 is wrong, which would mean either the reduction or the surjectivity of L fails somewhere it was not checked
what_a_miss_would_mean.P16_to_P20: the dimension count is necessary but not sufficient -- generic rank is not attained at the counting bound. That would leave the regime law standing and demote the threshold formula to a lower bound.
what_a_miss_would_mean.any_of_them: the reduction itself (Lemma A) is verified directly on 15 cells and would survive; what would fall is the step from the reduction to a closed form
